items.content:
Joaquin said cooking is commonplace alchemy — that it's the last thing
most people do that actually transforms one substance into another, and
that doing it badly for years still changes how you think about
everything else. He was three drinks in and I still can't stop turning it
over.

I am not a cook. I make the same four things. But I liked being told that
the four things count.

summary: A friend's remark reframes cooking badly as still transformative
title: Joaquin on cooking as commonplace alchemy
